title: Top selling products with CTE
statement_markdown: Write a query to find information based on order_items, products.
hints: Review the problem statement and expected output.
reference_solution: SELECT p.name, ps.total FROM products p JOIN (SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS total FROM order_items GROUP BY product_id) ps ON ps.product_id = p.id ORDER BY ps.total DESC LIMIT 3
